Package index

Metacells (SEACells + mcRigor)

Optional upstream aggregation of single cells into metacells before program discovery. Requires the suggested packages Seurat, mcRigor and basilisk (the SEACells Python environment is built on first use).

MetacellsByGroupsSEACells()
Construct metacells by groups with SEACells and mcRigor QC
OptimizeGammaSEACells()
Optimize SEACells granularity with mcRigor
GetMetacellSEACells()
Access metacell results stored by MetacellsByGroupsSEACells
